title: See what a v1 install's rules and settings become in Entra Policy Suite 2.0
purpose: Reads a v1 Entra Policy Suite folder (the tagging CSV files and the two configs) and shows the plan: the rule cards, tag types and values, settings, break-glass accounts, admin units, target groups and service tags, with the hints on the rules. It writes nothing. The import itself is done in the web app (Overview > Import v1, a SuperAdmin): upload the same files, look at the plan, approve - Entra Policy Suite writes it. With -Apply the script lists the files to upload.
whenToRun: Before the move from v1, to see the plan on the machine that has the v1 folder - optional: the Import v1 page shows the same plan.

runAs.name: read access to the v1 folder
runAs.why: the CSV files and configs are read

parameters.name: Path
parameters.help: the v1 DATA folder, or the folder that holds DATA

parameters.name: UserTaggingScript
parameters.help: for the attribute per tag type

parameters.name: OutFile
parameters.help: also save the plan as JSON

parameters.name: Apply
parameters.help: list the files to upload on the Import v1 page (nothing is written)

parameters.name: ConnectionString
parameters.help: no longer used - the script never connects to the database

whatIf: The script always only reads and shows; -WhatIf changes nothing about that.
undo: Nothing to undo: the script writes nothing. An import made on the Import v1 page is journaled in the change history and its rules can be removed as a set; the v1 install is never changed, so v1 keeps running until it is switched off.
